thread:
casey_marketing: Quick check — OrionCloud case story + webinar assets. We want a short customer story publish + a 20-min webinar clip for the June 12 launch. Deliverables we need: 1) 15-min interview (record) 2) hero quote we can show on page 3) legal release + logo ok 4) 3 metric callouts (latency, cost, error rate) Customer said they want to review the quote draft before publish. Who can own approvals and timeline?
aj: I can run the interview, 15 min works. Available June 5 or June 8, morning PT. Will capture recording + raw transcript.
maria: Marketing has booked the webinar slot June 12, 11:00am PT. We need final approved quote & assets by end of day June 9 to hit runway for slides and landing page.
ben_prod: I’ll take the blog draft + 2 social snippets. Need transcript, 2 short soundbites (10–20s), 1 hero quote, and final logo SVG.
lex_legal: Please use the standard Customer Release form and cc legal@redwood.com when sending to the customer. Key things: (a) confirm the exact customer name and logo file to use, (b) customer signatory (name + title), (c) confirm that metric callouts are OK with their finance/legal. Draft a quote and I’ll pre-review. Do not include any PII or contract-sensitive language. Use this release: https://redwood-internal/release-templates/customer-release-v3.pdf
casey_marketing: Draft hero quote suggestion for review: "OrionCloud reduced inference latency by 3.8x and cut per-request cost by 62% after migrating to Redwood Dedicated." @lex_legal pre-review?
lex_legal: Suggest edits: avoid naming a specific product in the quote. Rephrase to "after adopting Redwood's inference platform." Also round the cost change: say "~60%" instead of an exact 62% unless they sign off. So: "OrionCloud reduced inference latency by ~3.8x and reduced per-request cost by ~60% after adopting Redwood's inference platform."
casey_marketing: Updated quote: "OrionCloud reduced inference latency by ~3.8x and reduced per-request cost by ~60% after adopting Redwood's inference platform."
aj: Recording plan — Otter + local backup. I’ll share a folder with the raw mp4 + Otter transcript. Customer contact is Priya Shah (Head of ML). They said they can do June 5, 9:30am PT. I’ll send calendar invite now.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: Interview — OrionCloud (Priya Shah) — Jun 5 09:30 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood/evt/987654321
lex_legal: Thanks. Next: send the draft quote and release form to Priya, cc legal@redwood.com. Also ensure we get an explicit approval on the three metrics and the logo. If they request changes, have them approve in an email thread.
ben_prod: For the blog, I’ll pull three metric callouts into one infographic: latency (3.8x), cost (~60%), 99th p99 SLA improvement. Can we confirm the p99 improvement number before publishing?
maria: We need final assets (quote, logo, transcript, 2 soundbites, hero image) in the shared drive by COB Jun 9. I’ll slot the hero quote on the webinar slide deck once it’s approved.
casey_marketing: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) Send draft quote + release (casey) — today 2) Legal pre-review (lex_legal) — today 3) Interview recording (aj) — Jun 5 4) Transcripts/clips (aj) — Jun 6 5) Final quote approval (customer + lex_legal) — by Jun 9 6) Assets to marketing folder (casey/ben_prod) — Jun 9 7) Webinar slides + blog publish ready — Jun 11
lex_legal: Small add: include a short attribution line in docs: "OrionCloud (customer name as provided) — used with permission." Also keep an audit trail of the approval email.
aj: Shared folder link after recording: https://drive.redwood/orioncloud-case/rec-17382 (I'll post raw files there after call)
casey_marketing: Thanks all — I’ll post the draft quote + release to Priya now and ping when sent. Will try to get the logo file from their marketing contact in vector format.
maria: Ping me once quote is accepted — I’ll finalize slide deck and marketing schedule.
casey_marketing: Sent to Priya and cc'd legal@redwood.com. Copy of sent message (snippet):
```
casey_marketing to Priya Shah @OrionCloud:
Hi Priya — thanks again. Draft quote attached and customer release form. Please let us know any edits; if you approve we will use the following for the landing page and webinar slide: "OrionCloud reduced inference latency by ~3.8x and reduced per-request cost by ~60% after adopting Redwood's inference platform." Also please attach preferred logo (SVG) and confirm who can sign the release.
```
lex_legal: Received. I’ll follow up if they request edits. Keep me in the loop on the exact signatory.
aj: Confirmed — recording done Jun 5, uploaded. Transcript and two clips available in folder.
ben_prod: Got transcript + clips. Draft blog will be ready for review Jun 8.
maria: All good on my end. Thanks team!
